tool.name: PyEuk report
tool.description: render a self-contained graphical HTML report from a cluster SWEEP.json, PyEuk report

param.name: sweep_json
param.label: Cluster sweep (JSON)
param.help: A *_SWEEP.json written by the PyEuk cluster tool (its sweep output). Holds the supported cluster-count range, the per-branch confidence tree, and the stable cores.

param.label: Distance matrix (optional)
param.help: Optional distance matrix for the tree-ordered heatmap.

param.label: Layout
param.option: dashboard -- at-a-glance tiles, tree, sweep, heatmap

param.label: Theme
param.help: Theme. galaxy uses no external assets; studio links Google Fonts.
param.option: galaxy -- system fonts, no external assets (for viewing inside Galaxy)
studio -- Fraunces/Inter via Google Fonts (for standalone viewing)

tool.help:
Renders a clustering sweep as one self-contained HTML page. Input is the SWEEP.json written by the cluster tool; output is a single HTML file.
The page shows the range of cluster counts the data supports, whether that count is determined, a per-branch confidence tree with the stable cores marked, and -- if the distance matrix is supplied -- a tree-ordered distance heatmap. In the galaxy theme it uses no JavaScript and no external assets, so it renders correctly inside Galaxy; the studio theme links Google Fonts for standalone viewing.
The cluster tool can emit this report itself. Use this tool to re-render an existing sweep in a different layout or theme without recomputing. @HELP_FOOTER@
